author: JeTePardonne
body:
Dear Avicus Staff, 

On the dates June 6th, 2014, and July 14th,  2014, I was given two warnings for my language and my vulgarity. I was seeking to get these lifted because they were from such a long time ago, and also I feel like I have cleaned up my act when it comes to foul language and vulgarity. Out of my collection of infractions I have received, I have not received one for vulgarity or language since I was given these two. I hope these two infractions can be lifted, thanks :). 

WhatLiesBeaneath

title: Appeal

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hey WhatLiesBeneath,

I don't think you'll be able to appeal those two infractions considering that they're two years old and are only warns; senior staff won't be able to log check from that long ago furthermore. If you're concerned about your amount of infractions, I wouldn't worry seeing as those infractions aren't within 8 months of your last punishment. Anyway, that's just my two cents, so I would wait for a senior staff member to respond for an official reply. Good luck!
